call_purpose: You wanted the autoresponder email to reach the leads coming in from your form.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you switched on the autoresponder option in your form settings and saved it, and after a test form submission you confirmed the autoresponder email arrived.

covered.text: We explained that emails can sometimes land in spam, so verifying your sender domain is a good idea; you can do it in the email domain section of your settings.

customer_next_steps.text: Verify your sender domain in the email domain section of your settings.
